answer: Sequential work credit: each identity must complete a public proof-of-work chain to join, and every clone restarts at zero. The ridge of accumulated credits gates access to higher-value tasks, so forged identities earn nothing until they repeat the full chain. A single verified atlas of completed work records each chain seed, and the summit of available rewards sits beyond reach of any fresh clone. An attacker pays the full compute and time cost per clone, while the marginal clone yields a strictly negative expected value.
